title: Secret authority and future Secret Broker integration
summary: Queue Transport currently retains a direct keyHex constructor compatibility surface, but production key material should be resolved from the existing Secret Broker by reference at a trusted runtime boundary. Queue Transport must not become a competing secret authority.
invariants: keyId is metadata/selection identity, not permission and not secret material.
Do not persist or expose raw PSKs in queue definitions, allocator capabilities, NoSQL projections, logs or command lines.
Secret-reference-native endpoint registration and key rotation is a future integration increment.
Preserve the transport API/semantics while changing how trusted runtime code obtains the PSK.

provenance.claim: Secret authority boundary and compatibility keyHex surface.
Production secret handling uses Secret Broker by reference; no duplicate secret authority.
Qualification records keyId metadata, NoSQL key exclusion and future secret-reference integration.
